column3: the Maruts received help from Indra's side in a time of difficulty
column4: ಇಂದ್ರನು ... ಮರುತ್ತುಗಳಿಂದ ಕಷ್ಟಕಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಹಾಯವನ್ನು ಪಡೆದು (Indra received help from the Maruts)
column5: The direction of the help is reversed: the Kannada says Indra obtained help from the Maruts in a difficult time, not that the Maruts received help from Indra.

column4: ವ್ಯಾಕರಣಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯಾ (no Ṛk number on this page)
